Restore an Archived Record

User manual · English · 9 steps
Learn how to find an archived record with the Archived filter and bring it back, using a time off type as the example.

1. Open Time Off

Open the Time Off app.

2. Configuration menu

Open the Configuration menu.

3. Time Off Types

Click Time Off Types.

4. Search options

Click here to open the search options.

5. Archived filter

Click Archived to show only the archived records.

6. Find the record

Type the name of the record and press Enter.

7. Select it

Tick the box in front of the record.

9. Unarchive
